<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Runs test cases to ensure digest methods produce consistent outputs.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    void: Verifies that the default digest method matches SHA1 and SHA512 for the given input.

Description: This function is used to validate the behavior of the `Serializer` class when different digest methods are specified. It ensures that the default digest method produces the same output as explicitly setting the SHA1 and SHA512 digest methods. The function is called to verify the correctness of the serialization process under various digest configurations.
</DOCSTRING>
